dataList.content:
I always wanted to get rich.
我一直都想变得有钱。

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Uh... what would I do once I got rich...?
呃……变得有钱以后吗？

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
I, uh... haven't really thought that far ahead...
那、那我还没有想过……

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Oh, right! My fabric reservation! Thanks for reminding me. I'd better get going!
啊，对了！面料预约！谢谢你提醒我。那我走了！

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Hello! I'm here to pick up the fabric I reserved. I was told it would be ready...
你好！我是来取预约好的面料的……

Are you sure that shroud of yours doesn't need mending? You're happy leaving it as it is?
你身上那件寿衣不用改吗？
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
Sunshine is pouring into the Alteration Shop.
阳光洒落的改衣室。

Another customer is there talking to Miss Alterationist. He has a faded golden cloak over his shoulders.
一位肩披褪色的黄金披风的顾客，正对着改衣师小姐说着些什么。

I thought this was exactly the right season to come by. But seeing the customer ahead of me, I wonder if I've shown up a little early.
我还以为来这里的季度正正好，但好像还是来早了一点。

I don't know what you want to do with those scissors...
虽然我不知道你想用这把剪刀做什么……
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
But you've got that desire in you... enough that I can see you coming back to have me severed someday.
但能从中看出你似乎怀着总有一天要将我剪碎的热切期望。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
When that day comes, you know whose alteration services to go with.
到那时候，一定要来改衣啊。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
The customer nods along as Miss Alterationist speaks. Then, with his business apparently concluded, he turns and walks in my direction.
对着改衣师小姐的话点头的顾客似乎办完了事，朝着我走了过来。

When he sees me, his mouth falls open in apparent surprise... Then he tilts his head, like he's counting something.
那个人一看见我就惊讶地张大了嘴巴……随后便歪着头数了什么东西一会儿。

I try to place him. Did we meet somewhere before? But I can't recall ever seeing that style of clothing anywhere in the department store.
我试着在记忆中寻找他是不是我认识的顾客……但他身上是我在百货店里没见过的时尚。

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Oh... uh, hello. Nice to meet you...
呃……你、你好啊。

It was a clumsy attempt at a greeting, but I thought it might help break the ice...
我想着至少得缓和下窘迫的气氛，便打了个招呼，可是……

But he chuckled—scoffed, really—under his breath, as though he'd just worked something out. Whatever it was, he kept it to himself and left without a word.
那个人就像意识到了什么般轻轻笑了起来，一言不发地出去了。

The sunshine feels lovely, I know, but don't go basking in it all day. You don't want to end up like those Mannequins shambling around the shops.
虽然阳光很温暖，但是可别晒太多了。如果你不想变成店铺里到处游荡的人台那样的话。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
Here, come a little closer. The next customers won't know where they are in the queue if you stand over there.
为了不让下一位客人感到困惑，请到这边来吧。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Ah, right. Sorry about that.
啊，好！

Still thinking about the customer who just left? You've still got that look on your face.
很在意刚刚的那位客人吗？
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Haha... I just wasn't expecting to see a Rouge customer at your shop. I didn't think they'd have dealings with you, Miss Alterationist.
哈哈……我有点意外。本来还以为红派的客人和改衣师小姐您是没什么关系的。

Anyone who comes looking for fabric is welcome here.
只要是想要面料的客人，我都来者不拒。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
That's why I keep ignoring the Noirs when they ask me to run a shop for them. And believe me, they don't tire of asking.
所以就算黑派一直纠缠着要把店铺交给我来开，都被我无视了。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
Yours is all ready to go. Give me a moment to put the finishing touches on this other one. Won't be much longer.
你要的已经准备好了。我把这些做好后就给你，稍等一下哦。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
You have to treat such pure, noble material with care... It's not the sort of work you can just put down to pick up again later.
因为这些纯粹而高贵的材料需要被小心对待……所以很难在中途停下手来。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
The fabric resting in her lap had a radiance I'd never seen before. I'd looked at plenty of fabrics by now, but nothing with a color quite like that.
在改衣师小姐的怀中，有着一块我从未见过而又光彩夺目的面料。

Most fabrics I've seen so far had to be scrutinized to get an idea of how much of each material was in them... But this one? I could tell it's high-purity just by looking.
和其他必须确认含量的面料不同……它一眼看上去就有着十分高的纯度。

How many eyeballs would it take to buy fabric like that...? I couldn't even begin to put a price on it.
那种面料……要花多少眼球才能买到啊？

Maybe if I spent hundreds of seasons picking up eyeballs on 1F... No, who am I kidding? Even that wouldn't put it within reach.
要是在1F徘徊上几百个季度……不，就算那样我也买不起。

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
That piece you're working on... is it something the Noirs asked you to make?
你现在在缝的是……黑派的委托吗？

Mmhmm. Their Brand Manager did.
没错，是黑派品牌经理的委托。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
Golden Fabric for their armor... something suitably "righteous" and "exalted". That was the request.
那人想要饱含正义的高贵黄金面料，用于制作自己的铠甲。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
All this beautiful fabric... and it's going to end up as armor? Really...?
要用这么漂亮的面料做铠甲吗……？

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Wouldn't it be lovely as a dress, though...? It'd be so much better that way...
做成礼服的话……会更好看吧……

Overlay each ply of fabric, layer after layer... and you can make a suit of armor with plenty of strength and very little weight.
层层叠起……就能做成轻柔而坚韧的铠甲。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
It'll give them an edge in their competition with the Rouges.
这肯定会在他们与红派的竞争中派上大用场。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Competition... Oh, so that's why it's been so hard to get a reservation lately.
竞争……所以最近才很难预约上啊。

Well, customers may have to get in line while I work on the Noirs' bulk fabric order... I can't even squeeze in much time to handle odd jobs.
因为黑派每个季度都会下大量的订单，所以连零碎的时间都不剩了。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
Her work apparently finished, Miss Alterationist carefully set the Golden Fabric down.
改衣师小姐似乎完成了工作，轻轻放下了黄金面料。

Now that she's done with the Noirs' order, it's my turn, finally... I've been waiting for this for seasons. I'm actually going to get my fabric...
我翘首以盼好几个季度的面料，终于能……

Here you go. The embroidered fabric you asked for. See the threads winding through each other? That's how I made that dense, lush forest pattern.
给，是你要的带刺绣的面料。是用相互交织的线制作出的如繁茂的森林一般的花纹哦。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Whoa. If I put this around my cuffs... the whole outfit would look so much more elegant...
哇啊……用这个装饰袖口的话……似乎能更添一份优雅呢……

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Thank you! I'll be sure to come to you again next time!
十分感谢！我会再来的！

So, where are you headed now?
接下来你要去哪儿呢？

dataList.content:
I'd meant to go back down to a good spot I knew on 1F. Gather some eyeballs there, then head up to 4F.
我本来打算去1F的好地方收集一些眼球，再去4F。

I was going to find a bag from the Handbags Hall to go with the dress I'm working on...
在箱包馆买一只搭配刚刚做好的礼服的包的……

Except my eyes wouldn't stay on anything else. They kept returning to that Golden Fabric, sitting right where she'd put it down.
可放在那里的黄金面料却一次次地进入我的视线。

If I went down to the basement floors... if I could find materials like that for myself...
要是在地下……我也能拿到这般材料的话……

dataList.title:
Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
I think I'll head... down to the basement floors, actually.
我准备……去地下。

dataList.title:

褐派
dataList.content:
There's supposed to be a drink on B1F that can taste like anything you want. Or, um... that's what I've heard, at least.
据说……在B1F里，有一种能喝到自己喜欢的味道的饮料。

Fuhu... I can see where this is going. But getting hold of the materials for this fabric won't be nearly as easy as you're hoping.

dataList.title:
Alteration Shop

dataList.content:
Still... the porters tell me there's plenty down there that's nothing like what we have above ground. You might find something different, at least.
但是……据搬运工们说，地下有许多和地上截然不同的东西。

褐派
dataList.content:
So, how many eyeballs do I owe you? This looks way too good to pay just 200, like last time...
我该给你多少眼球呢？这么好的面料，像上次那样给200枚似乎不够……

That one...? Just take it. You don't have to pay.

dataList.title:

You know the rumor about a legendary sword that started going around on 4F? I brought it to 1F and 3F myself! Has it reached you yet?

褐派
dataList.content:
Uh, "balance"...?

The Rouges' Boutiques are finding their feet again. You could pretty much say they're the ones setting the trends now.
红派精品店一个个都恢复了活力。就算说他们如今引领了潮流也不奇怪。
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
The Noir Brand Manager's running all over the place, trying to keep up... but that won't be enough to turn things around.

dataList.content:
There's a Voice guiding the Rouges now... and it has an answer for every move. As if it had the whole thing figured out before it even began.
如今引导着红派的声音……就像是料想到了一切一般，正在进行完美的反击呢。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

连已经脱线了都没意识到。
dataList.title:
Alteration Shop
改衣室

dataList.content:
Anyway, that's all I need you to pass on. I'm counting on you, dear customer.
我想让你传达的就这些。拜托了，客人。
dataList.title:

Le Kaki
褐派
dataList.content:
Of course! I'll make sure the message gets through, just as you said.
好！我一定会传达到的。

I'd said my goodbyes and was about to leave when figures dressed in red began filing into the Alteration Shop, one after another.
就在我准备道别出门的时候，改衣室外面进来了一个又一个身着红色衣服的人。

So she really did get plenty of Rouge customers... Maybe I'd simply never been around at the right time to see them.
原来真的是我来的时间不对，改衣室里也会来很多红派的顾客啊……

That was what I was thinking as I made for the entrance... when a pair of scissors came flying into my path.
就在我这么想着向入口走去的时候，一把剪刀飞到了我的面前。

There was a nail, made of bone, embedded in the scissors... and only then did I realize that one of the Rouges had thrown it at me. The scissors blocked it.
剪刀上……插着一根红派不知何时向我投来的骨钉。
